thread:
mira: Quick postmortem follow-up for Caldera on-prem peering flap — root cause = stale BGP advertisement + kernel netfilter race (isolation bug). Action items below.

alex_park: thx. can we enumerate owners + dates? i want a minimal rollback plan if patch risks tuning.

deploy-bot: Imported incident CAL-3421 into tracker https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CAL-3421

samir: Action 1) Fix netd race in isolation code. Owner: @tess. ETA: 2026-02-12
Action 2) Add BGP route validation & liveness probe. Owner: @alex_park. ETA: 2026-01-30
Action 3) Add CI synthetic peering test for on-prem topology. Owner: @samir. ETA: 2026-02-05
Action 4) Run audit across dedicated fleet for stale routes. Owner: infra-ops (cc @mira). ETA: 2026-01-28

tess: I can take the netd fix. Patch landed in draft branch: `fix/netd-isolation-race`. Code note:
```
# quick reproduction test
sudo ip netns exec caldera ip route add 10.0.0.0/24 via 192.168.100.1 metric 100
# reproduce flapping
while true; do ping -c1 10.0.0.5; sleep 1; done
```
I'll open PR today, request review from @alex_park.

alex_park: For BGP validation, let's add two rules:
- reject routes with overlapping tenant prefixes
- prefer control-plane learned routes over leak routes
I'll prototype a router linter script and post to #eng-networking.

mira: Also need comms to Caldera: @samir please send a short summary + planned ETA by EOD. Keep them in the loop for scheduled maintenance.

samir: Will do. Draft message:
"Hi Caldera team — we identified a race in our on-prem isolation layer causing transient overlap with internal routes. We're patching netd and adding BGP validation. ETA for fix: 2026-02-12. We'll schedule a maintenance window if needed. -Samir"
I'll send after @tess confirms PR.

oncall-bot: Reminder — follow-up check-in scheduled: 2026-02-20 15:00 UTC. Thread linked to CAL-3421.

tess: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2897. Requesting review from @alex_park and @mira. Nominate for 48-hour accelerated review.

alex_park: :thumbsup: I'll review tonight. Also adding a short playbook snippet to docs runbook: `/docs/runbooks/onprem-peering.md` — adding rollback steps and validation commands.

mira: Great. Closing loop: owners + ETAs confirmed, comms on standby. Reopen if anything shifts. :white_check_mark:
